verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs directly cover this story: connect an inbox to send one-to-one templated emails from the CRM and 'send sequences emails' (hubspot-docs-13/21/46/54), plus a dedicated sequences tool to 'send a series of targeted, timed' emails (hubspot-docs-37/44/52). This is native first-party CRM functionality, not third-party bolt-on. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of sequence creation workflow, and no detail on template management UI specifics.
